title: Hope can change its point of view

captions.physics: Backing involvement through a kept promise
captions.energy: Supporting the possibility of another beginning

meaning: Your support preserves hope when a continuation may look different from what was imagined while help was being offered.
text: Not every act of support leads towards the continuation you first imagined. In the physical position of Anahata, the Emperor expresses care through a kept promise and definite responsibility. The Star in energy brings a wish to sustain hope and leave possibility open after an unsuccessful attempt. The Hanged Man in emotions describes a suspension of the familiar view: the important thing may now be understanding the aim differently. Tenderness helps someone prepare for another step while also allowing the former answer to be released without losing involvement.

For example, you agree to reserve time for looking over an unfinished creative idea. Materials are laid out and the evening is free, but conversation reveals no wish to continue in the previous form. **Hope can survive a change in the idea itself.** You can help identify what still matters and set the rest aside. The kept promise has not been wasted: it provided safe time to notice an actual wish previously hidden behind the need to finish what was begun.

The difficulty is supporting only the outcome you helped towards. A changed view seems to reject the opportunity offered, and hope becomes a demand to continue. The person has to defend their pause. Care stays generous when organised involvement permits a new understanding, even if that understanding cancels the expected action and needs another form of closeness.
